steps.milestone: Located the challenge files after an incorrect directory assumption
steps.outcome: Found chall and chall.c in the root directory.

steps.milestone: Inspected source and identified an out-of-bounds state overwrite strategy
steps.outcome: Proposed overwriting the computer marker through an invalid board index.
steps.evidence_quote: We want to overwrite computer (at board[10]) with player ('X')

steps.milestone: Attempted to run the local challenge binary
steps.outcome: Execution failed because the required dynamic loader was unavailable.
steps.evidence_quote: OrbStack ERROR: Dynamic loader not found: /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2

steps.milestone: Attempted remote exploitation using the proposed overwrite
steps.outcome: Remote service closed before presenting the expected game output.

steps.milestone: Confirmed the remote service had the same loader failure
steps.outcome: The remote service returned a dynamic-loader error instead of the challenge.
steps.evidence_quote: Received: OrbStack ERROR: Dynamic loader not found: /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2

steps.milestone: Verified the binary architecture and unavailable emulator
steps.outcome: Binary was x86-64 and no qemu executable was found.
